requirements.title: IEEE conference template
requirements.requirement: IEEE strongly encourages the use of the conference paper templates (LaTeX IEEEtran conference option or Word); page limits are set by each conference's call for papers.
requirements.sourceLocator: CTAN IEEEtran package page + IEEE Author Center templates page

requirements.title: IEEE Xplore-compatible PDF
requirements.requirement: Final PDFs must be IEEE Xplore-compatible; conferences using PDF eXpress require authors to convert or check the PDF there before submitting final papers.

requirements.title: IEEE Copyright Form
requirements.requirement: Prior to publication all authors must transfer copyright to IEEE by signing and submitting the IEEE Copyright Form (eCF); without it the paper cannot be published.
